 Hon'Ble Sandeep Jain, J. 
1. Heard learned counsel for the appellants and learned counsel representing Noida.

2. The instant first appeal under Section 54 of the Land Acquisition Act, 1894 has been filed by the
land owners aggrieved against the award and decree dated 6.10.2016 passed by the court of
Additional District Judge/Special Judge (S.C./S.T., Act), Ghaziabad in L.A.R. No.329 of 1997, Ajay
Singh vs. State of U.P. & Anr., whereby for the land acquired in Village Chhalera Bangar, Tehsil
Dadri, District Ghaziabad now District Gautam Budh Nagar, compensation at the rate of Rs. 233/-
per square yard has been awarded, besides other statutory benefits, admissible under the Land
Acquisition Act, 1894.
3.

sentences.text:
Learned counsel for the appellant submitted that in this case land of Village Chhalera Bangar,
Tehsil Dadri, District Ghaziabad now Gautam Budh Nagar, was acquired vide notification under Section 4(1) of the Act dated 5.1.1991, the award of the Collector was made on 17.8.1996, whereby a meager compensation of Rs.110/- per square yard, besides other statutory benefits, were awarded to the land owners, aggrieved against which, the land owners had preferred reference which was allowed by the impugned award and decree dated 6.10.2016, whereby the compensation of the acquired land was enhanced to Rs. 233/- per square yard, besides other statutory benefits,
admissible under the Land Acquisition Act, 1894.

4. Learned counsel for the appellant further submitted that the matter regarding acquisition of land situated in Village Chhalera Bangar, Tehsil Dadri, District Ghaziabad now Gautam Budh Nagar vide notification dated 5.1.1991 has attained finality, since the matter has been decided by the Apex Court in the case of New Okhla Industrial Development Authority Vs. Harnand Singh (Deceased) through LRs & Ors., 2024 SCC OnLine SC 1691 whereby for similarly situated acquired land, the Apex Court has awarded compensation at the rate of Rs. 403/- per square yard, besides other statutory benefits,
admissible under the Land Acquisition Act, 1894.

entities.text: New Okhla Industrial Development Authority Vs. Harnand Singh (Deceased) through LRs & Ors., 2024 SCC OnLine SC 1691
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: 5. Learned counsel for the appellants further submitted that in view of the above judgment of the Apex Court, the appellants in the instant appeal are also entitled to get compensation at the rate of Rs. 403/- per square yard for their acquired land.

6. Per contra, learned counsel representing NOIDA fairly admitted that the matter has attained finality and the Apex Court has awarded a compensation of Rs. 403/- per square yard regarding,
similarly acquired land situated in Village Chhalera Bangar, Tehsil Dadri, District Ghaziabad now Gautam Budh Nagar in respect of notification dated 5.1.1991.
7.

Learned counsel representing NOIDA further submitted that the appellants may not be paid interest on the enhanced compensation awarded by this Court for the period during which the deficiency of the court fees was not made good by the appellants.
8. I have considered the submissions made by learned counsel for the parties and perused the record.

sentences.text: It is apparent that the instant appeal arises in respect of the land acquired in Village Chhalera Bangar, Tehsil Dadri, District Ghaziabad now Gautam Budh Nagar, through notification under Section 4(1) of the Act dated 5.1.1991, regarding which the award of the Collector was made on 17.8.1996, whereby only compensation at the rate of Rs. 110/- per square yard was awarded to the land owners, which was challenged by filing reference, which was allowed by impugned judgment and decree dated 6.10.2016, whereby the compensation was enhanced to Rs. 233/- per square yard.

10. It is also apparent that regarding, similarly acquired land situated in Village Chhalera Bangar,
Tehsil Dadri, District Ghaziabad now Gautam Budh Nagar, acquired through notification under Section 4(1) of the Act dated 5.1.1991, the matter has attained finality, because the Apex Court in the case of New Okhla Industrial Development Authority Vs. Harnand Singh (Deceased) through LRs &
Ors. 2024 SCC OnLine SC 1691 has awarded compensation at the rate of Rs. 403/- per square yard.

entities.text: New Okhla Industrial Development Authority Vs. Harnand Singh (Deceased)
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
In view of this, the appellants are also entitled to get the same amount of compensation for the similarly situated land, which was acquired through notification dated 5.1.1991.
11.
Accordingly, the instant appeal is allowed.

The appellants are entitled to get enhanced compensation for their acquired land, at the rate of Rs. 403/- per square yard, besides other statutory benefits, admissible to them under the Land Acquisition Act, 1894.
12.
The instant appeal was filed on 18.1.2017 but the deficiency of court fees was made good on 26.4.2019

, as such, the appellant is not entitled to get interest on the enhanced amount of compensation awarded by this Court, for the period from 18.1.2017 till 26.4.2019.
13.
However, in the facts and circumstances of the case, there shall be no order as to costs.
14. Office is directed to prepare the decree accordingly.
(Sandeep Jain,J.) September 8, 2025

opennyai_summary.ANALYSIS: It is apparent that the instant appeal arises in respect of the land acquired in Village Chhalera Bangar, Tehsil Dadri, District Ghaziabad now Gautam Budh Nagar, through notification under Section 4(1) of the Act dated 5.1.1991, regarding which the award of the Collector was made on 17.8.1996, whereby only compensation at the rate of Rs. 110/- per square yard was awarded to the land owners, which was challenged by filing reference, which was allowed by impugned judgment and decree dated 6.10.2016, whereby the compensation was enhanced to Rs. 233/- per square yard.
opennyai_summary.decision:
10. It is also apparent that regarding, similarly acquired land situated in Village Chhalera Bangar,
Tehsil Dadri, District Ghaziabad now Gautam Budh Nagar, acquired through notification under Section 4(1) of the Act dated 5.1.1991, the matter has attained finality, because the Apex Court in the case of New Okhla Industrial Development Authority Vs. Harnand Singh (Deceased) through LRs &
Ors. 2024 SCC OnLine SC 1691 has awarded compensation at the rate of Rs. 403/- per square yard.
In view of this, the appellants are also entitled to get the same amount of compensation for the similarly situated land, which was acquired through notification dated 5.1.1991.
11.

The appellants are entitled to get enhanced compensation for their acquired land, at the rate of Rs. 403/- per square yard, besides other statutory benefits, admissible to them under the Land Acquisition Act, 1894.

, as such, the appellant is not entitled to get interest on the enhanced amount of compensation awarded by this Court, for the period from 18.1.2017 till 26.4.2019.
13.
However, in the facts and circumstances of the case, there shall be no order as to costs.
14. Office is directed to prepare the decree accordingly.
